name: eol-normalizer
description: Normalize a written file's working-tree line endings to its .gitattributes eol value on edit: symmetric CRLF/LF driven by git check-attr, advisory and never blocking.

eol_normalizer_enabled.title: Normalize line endings on edit
eol_normalizer_enabled.description: Normalize a written file's line endings to its .gitattributes eol value

eol_normalizer_lint_gitignored.title: Act on files git ignores
eol_normalizer_lint_gitignored.description: By default the hook leaves a file the repository gitignores alone: it is not normalized, since a rewrite of an ignored file has no git checkout to undo it. Set true to act on gitignored files too. A tracked file that matches an ignore pattern is always in scope.
